arest.description: AREST engine 0.9.0, served by the RUST RESIDENT (arest --mcp). 40 verbs: reads, applies, orient/cells/query/derive compute natively over the retained sidecar store; the compiler-host verbs (compile/propose/induce/ask, sql, the read long tail) delegate to the same engine's python through cli.py — one first-class verb table, two bindings. Bound to the DEBUG build on purpose: release takes ~45min and debug ~2min, and this binary is meant to be changed constantly. Canon is not compiled in — engine/rust reads it from disk at startup — so editing arest costs a restart (~0.6s cold), never a rebuild; only host edits rebuild.
